BH POST GRADUATE DEPARTMENT OF ENGLISH

Sungli Bhaderwah 182222

Dated: 29/07/2024
Notice
The eligible candidates are invited for walk-in interview for the post
of Guest Lecturer in the Department of English, Bhaderwahd Campus,
University of Jammu. The appointment on the post will be purely on
temporary basis till further orders.
Interested eligible candidates should fill in the attached application
form supported by self-attested documents’ copies by 05-08-2024 in
the Academic Office and report to the office of the I/C Head
Department of English, Bhaderwah Campus for walk-in-interview on
06-08-2024 at 3:00 pm.
I/C Head
BH POST GRADUATE DEPARTMENT OF ENGLISH
BHADERWAH CAMPUS
UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU
Sungli Bhaderwah 182222
TERMS & CONDITITIONS
1. The Guest Lecturer shall be eligible for remuneration as
per the University norms.
2. The candidate will not be entitled to any other benefits,
which are admissible to the regular employees of
University of Jammu.
3. This engagement will not vest any right to claim for
regular appointment in University of Jammu or for
continued services in the University.
4. The University reserves the right to terminate this
engagement any time in case of unsatisfactory
performance, misconduct or any other administrative
reasons/compulsions.
5. In case of any dispute/ambiguity that may occur in the pro
cess of selection, the decision of the University shall be
final.
6. Candidates must report at Bhaderwah Campus for Walk-
In-Interview on prescribed date and time along with all
supporting documents in original.
7. The University reserves the rights to cancel this
Walk in Interview at any stage without giving any advance
notice or reasons.
I/C Head
UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU
